description: [FILED BY: Polybius the Decider, executing the Grand's 2026-07-10 terminal-parade amendments. PROBLEM FRAMING.] The new doctrine (supersession includes disposal) needs a MECHANISM: the launcher records seat sid but NOT the terminal process PID, so an agent flipping a seat dead cannot SAFELY identify which window to close (name-matching pwsh windows risks killing the wrong one — several seats share the name POLYBIUS_the-stoa across generations). NEEDED (shape = team's): launch-team.ps1 records the spawned process PID (and window handle if cheap) into the stoa--reg seat record; a small dispose-seat helper closes by recorded PID with liveness+identity check (process still exists AND commandline matches the recorded sid) before kill; falls back to the batched PRINCIPAL close-list when identification fails. INTERIM RULE (already encoded in both SKILL.md layers): agent-side close only where safely identifiable, else batched close-list. Cross-ref: the zombie-seat class (2026-07-10) — disposal also shrinks the stale-monitor re-fire surface.
title: team-launcher: record PID at launch + agent-side window disposal — supersession-includes-disposal needs safe window identification
